messages:
chris: Heads up — Sales needs a temporary quota bump for ACME demo tomorrow. Org: org_9876. They expect ~3x token QPS for 30m. Can we get a short-lived lift? cc @sara
sara: Do we have denylist/abuse flags for org_9876? I don't want to open a hole. Also need billing sign-off.
sara: @chris can you share requestor email and why burst is needed (demo cadence)?
chris: Requestor is emily@acme.com, demo to CTO at 10am PST. It's strictly read-only prompts. We'll monitor.
devin: If we're doing temporary increases, we should do token-level lease with TTL + audit. Implement as ephemeral lease tied to API key and org. No permanent change to quotas.
devin: Quick sketch:
```
POST /internal/quotas/leases
{ \"org_id\": \"org_9876\", \"api_key\": \"sk-prod-XXX\", \"qps\": 1200, \"duration_secs\": 1800, \"reason\": \"Sales demo 2026-04-01\" }
```
maya: we also need to check denylist for IPs and recent abuse signals. We should auto-block if error rate > 5% in first minute.
rl-bot: Audit report for org_9876: last 90 days -> requests: 12k, incidents: 0, recent spikes: none. No denylist matches. (this is a system msg)
devin: Good. Two safety gates: 1) TTL lease with expiry and 2) auto-revoke on anomalies + telemetry flagging to console.
maya: Console UX idea: \"Request temporary quota\" button in Support -> Quotas. Pop up captures reason + SLA owner + approver. Creates lease and Jira automatically. Also show a live \"burst\" meter.
sara: approve on safety as long as Sales signs the AFA and we add a billing guard. chris: Sales can sign, but need <1 hour turnaround.
devin: Ops-wise implement a soft-path: route burst to sandbox nodes (dedicated pool) first, then fallback to paid pool. That protects main tenant performance.
maya: we'll need a routing policy change: traffic with lease token -> route_policy: burst_pool: true, override_batching: true. Sample config:
```
routing_policy:
  name: burst_lease_route
  match: { lease: true }
  target_pool: burst-gpu-pool
  qos: low_latency
```
sara: Also log a 'lease_granted' event to telemetry with lease_id, api_key_sha256, approver.
chris: can we have an emergency rollback? if something looks off, Support clicks 'revoke' which calls DELETE /internal/quotas/leases/:id
devin: yep - revoke endpoint + revoke should be immediate and emit trace to console + send slack alert to #eng-oncall.
maya: we should add rate-limiter metrics per-lease in console: allowed qps, used qps, error rate, latency p95.
rl-bot: Created ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4521 (ephemeral quotas + UI). Assigned to devin, severity: P2.
chris: perfect. Sales will wait for confirmation. Can someone provision for org_9876 for tomorrow 09:45 PST -> 10:15 PST? (request window slightly earlier)
sara: I'll approve once ticket is updated with approver and billing ack.
devin: I'll prototype the lease API today, put a feature flag behind 'ephemeral_quotas'. Will link PR later.
maya: I'll mock the console flow and put screenshots in the ticket.
chris: thanks team :thumbsup:
sara: tagging @oncall to FYI if anything trips: @alex (eng-oncall)
alex: noted. I'll watch the channel tomorrow during window.
chris: last note - ensure audit retention for lease events is 1 year per compliance.
devin: added to ticket.
